report:
Reviewed the complete claim, ordinary span.rs implementation, and both associated tests. The claim requires a source-root absolute span in one ParseSource, immediate-owner-relative placement for nested definitions, definition-relative signature CST/body CST/typed-body offsets, and composition through every owner to the root. AbsoluteSpan stores exactly one source and two endpoints; resolve preserves that source and adds the owner start to both relative endpoints. RelativeSpan represents the intended relative offsets. This proves the local arithmetic, not that all producers and nested resolution paths use the right origin.

The ordinary moving_associated_items_preserves_symbol_query_keys test covers trait/impl functions, types, and constants under preceding-sibling insertion and reordering, then reverses each edit. It asserts immediate owner equality and absence of observer reexecution, not actual span endpoints. Captured setup_root_module constructs a file-root absolute range; the captured interned ObservedSymbol and tracked observer explain the query-identity observation. A wrong relative origin could escape those assertions; coordinate verification remains explicitly deferred.

The TODO types_spans_relative_composition has no behavioral assertions and explicitly requires attributes/signatures/bodies/associated/error/zero-width/generated-text coordinate fixtures before and after item and sibling movement. Completion requires those fixtures with expected root source and composed endpoints through nested owners, including definition-relative CST and typed nodes. This existing deferral adequately accounts for the unverified producers and full recursive composition; it is not a claim of complete implementation or coverage. No edits are requested to this unchanged accounting.

Baseline: independently compared all three historical implementation_sources/test_sources files byte-for-byte with current files and confirmed exact matches. Reassessed the supplied historical rationale against current complete claim, metadata, test bodies and captured helper context. Source review only: ran review start/read and baseline-comparison commands, and submit this report with review record; no behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 functional sage-meta tests and a successful root build.
